data.description:
## Testing Mode: UPDATE

Update plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md Phase A to call mode-detect.sh and emit the MODE banner. Update/create structural test asserting banner strings appear in SKILL.md Phase A.

## Story DD Coverage
This task satisfies:
- DD1: MODE: local banner gating subsequent ci-pr-only mechanisms
- DD2: MODE: ci-pr banner enabling PR creation

## What to Change in SKILL.md

In Phase A, after the 'Validate Primary Ticket' step (specifically after step 3 — mark in_progress), add a new section:

### Mode Detection

Detect whether per-story PR mechanisms are active for this sprint run:

```bash
SPRINT_MODE=$(bash "$PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/mode-detect.sh")  # shim-exempt: internal orchestration script
```

Emit exactly one banner based on the result:
- If SPRINT_MODE=ci-pr: emit `MODE: ci-pr`
- If SPRINT_MODE=local: emit `MODE: local — per-story PR mechanisms inactive`

When SPRINT_MODE=local: all ci-pr-only mechanisms (S4–S10 behaviors: per-story PR creation, trailer enforcement, story-level review gates, merge orchestration, cross-story diff analysis) are **inactive for this sprint run**. Do not attempt to create PRs or enforce story-level trailers.

When SPRINT_MODE=ci-pr: per-story PR mechanisms are active. Proceed with normal sprint flow.

## File Impact

### Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md (Phase A, after Validate Primary Ticket)
- tests/hooks/test-sprint-skill-push-before-dispatch.sh (or new test file for MODE banner assertions)

### Files to Optionally Create
- tests/hooks/test-sprint-skill-mode-banner.sh (new structural test if preferred over extending existing)

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] sprint/SKILL.md Phase A contains exactly one Mode Detection section
- [ ] sprint/SKILL.md contains 'SPRINT_MODE=$(bash' and 'mode-detect.sh'
- [ ] sprint/SKILL.md contains 'MODE: ci-pr'
- [ ] sprint/SKILL.md contains 'MODE: local — per-story PR mechanisms inactive'
- [ ] Structural test exists and asserts all four strings above in SKILL.md content
- [ ] Structural test is executable and passes (exit 0)
- [ ] No duplicate MODE sections introduced
- [ ] ShellCheck passes on structural test file

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user
data.title: UPDATE: Wire mode-detect.sh into sprint Phase A MODE banner
